- **self**: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting (14/2)

## How it works

- [statement] Aero `getAmountsForLiquidity` returns only token0 when the current square-root price is at or below the lower bound, both assets strictly between bounds, and only token1 at or above the upper bound. Use current pool price and position liquidity to value principal; this helper does not add uncollected fees or emissions. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] For an unstaked NFT with nonzero liquidity, `collect` first pokes the pool with a zero-liquidity burn and adds each inside-fee-growth delta multiplied by position liquidity and divided by `FixedPoint128.Q128` to the stored owed balance. When position liquidity is zero, `collect` skips that poke and fee-growth update and collects only from the stored owed balances. For a position with liquidity, stored `tokensOwed0` and `tokensOwed1` alone can omit fees accrued since the previous update. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/NonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] For a staked NFT, `positions` substitutes current pool inside-fee growth for the returned fee checkpoint. When the position has nonzero liquidity, `collect` refreshes the stored fee-growth snapshot from the gauge-owned pool position without adding a fresh fee-growth delta to the NFT owed balances; with zero liquidity it skips that refresh. Applying the unstaked fee formula blindly to a gauge-owned NFT can misclassify its earnings. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/NonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] The `earned` function in CLGauge projects unsettled cumulative gauge rewards into pool reward growth in memory when active staked liquidity exists. It validates position ownership, applies penalty before referral share, and adds account-level `deferredEmissions`. Treat this result as an account estimate including deferred withdrawals, not simply the gross rewards of the currently selected NFT. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] The published CLGaugeFactory constructor defaults are `DEFAULT_MIN_STAKE_BLOCKS = 5` and a `DEFAULT_PENALTY_RATE` equal to `MAX_PIPS`. Gauge divides the penalty by `MAX_PIPS` imported from `ProtocolConstants.sol`, where that constant represents 100%, so the default early penalty is the full accrued reward. Gauge applies the configured rate only while the current block is strictly below deposit block plus the minimum, so the boundary block is eligible without that penalty. These are source defaults, not a verified live Base configuration. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting · also: https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol, https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/libraries/ProtocolConstants.sol

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Read `effectivePenaltyConfig` for the target gauge before scheduling a claim or rebalance: the factory penalty administrator can change the factory minimum and rate, and can override the minimum for an individual gauge. A zero per-gauge override falls back to the factory minimum. Source defaults therefore cannot establish the target gauge's current holding period or forfeit percentage. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGaugeFactory.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] `decreaseLiquidity` credits removed principal to `tokensOwed0` and `tokensOwed1` and also credits fee-growth deltas, then reduces position liquidity. `collect` subsequently transfers from the owed balances. A bot must distinguish withdrawn principal from fee income instead of treating the entire collect amount as yield. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/NonfungiblePositionManager.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] The CL pool credits realized emissions to `rewardGrowthGlobalX128` per unit of active staked liquidity. With no active staked liquidity it banks emissions in rollover instead. CLGauge computes each position reward as inside reward-growth delta times its liquidity divided by `Q128`; the claim path forfeits returned rollover rather than awarding that idle-period accrual to a later depositor. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/core/CLPool.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting · also: https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For principal valuation, let L be position liquidity and a < s < b be normalized lower, current and upper square-root prices. The in-range amounts are token0 = L*(b-s)/(s*b) and token1 = L*(s-a). Aero implements these in `getAmountsForLiquidity` with fixed-point integer helpers; Uniswap documents the same in-range formulas. (medium confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting · also: https://blog.uniswap.org/uniswap-v3-math-primer-2
- [statement] Aero `getLiquidityForAmounts` uses the token0 budget below the range and the token1 budget above it. In range it computes candidate liquidity from each token budget and takes the smaller value; desired deposit amounts therefore need not both be fully consumed. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/periphery/libraries/LiquidityAmounts.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] In the pool source, mixed-liquidity fee splitting first rounds up the staked share of swap fees, then rounds up an additional `unstakedFee()` levy on the remaining fee share using denominator of one million. The residual fee growth is divided only by unstaked active liquidity. If all active liquidity is staked, all swap fees go to gauge fees; a fee-earning LP does not necessarily retain its entire pro-rata swap fee share. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/core/CLPool.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] The official documentation describes MinStake forfeiture on early withdrawal. The CLGauge source additionally applies the same penalty through an ordinary emissions claim while the NFT remains staked: `_claimPositions` invokes `_computePositionEmissions`, which advances the growth checkpoint and applies `_applyPenalty`. Early claiming can therefore permanently forfeit the accrued slice without withdrawing principal; withdrawal-only wording is incomplete for bot scheduling. (low confidence) — https://aero.xyz/llms-full.txt · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting · also: https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol, https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/Gauge.sol
- [statement] On deposit, CLGauge collects existing pool fees to the credited owner, transfers the NFT into gauge custody, stakes its liquidity, and records both an inside-reward-growth checkpoint and `depositBlock`. Ordinary reward computation updates the growth checkpoint but does not reset the deposit block. A new deposit after withdrawal stamps a new holding-period start. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
- [statement] The normal CLGauge withdrawal path collects fees, attempts to claim emissions, then unstakes liquidity and returns the NFT. If emission minting reverts, `_claimOrDeferPositionEmissions` records net LP rewards in account-level `deferredEmissions` for a later claim; a successful NFT withdrawal therefore need not imply a successful emission payout. (low confidence) — https://github.com/dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public/blob/main/contracts/gauge/CLGauge.sol · keywords: Slipstream position math and fee and reward accounting
